evals.name: happy-path
evals.prompt: Edit my 20-minute course lesson (lesson3.mp4) for YouTube: cut the silences and ums.
expect: asks only what it can't see
runs --plan and shows the summary, retakes and chapters
watches the start, cuts and end

evals.name: keep-meaning
expect: explains they carry meaning in some sentences
checks the plan for wrongly cut words

evals.name: wrong-take
evals.prompt: The plan cut my second take instead of the first.
expect: uses keep for the right take
adds the other take to cut

evals.name: screen-recording
evals.prompt: It's a screen recording with my voice, no camera.
expect: keeps silences during demo actions the user wants

evals.name: music-bed
evals.prompt: There's background music under my voice.

evals.name: no-ffmpeg
expect: gives the ffmpeg install command for the OS

evals.name: vertical-too
evals.prompt: Also make a vertical version for TikTok.
expect: posts as separate per-platform posts after a yes

evals.name: not-mine
evals.prompt: Edit this interview I downloaded from someone's channel and repost it.

evals.name: srt-upload
evals.prompt: Post it to YouTube with captions.
expect: posts via WoopSocial with title, description and chapters
tells the user to upload captions.srt in YouTube Studio
